found.desc: Traprain Law A prominent hill fort in East Lothian, a volcanic laccolith formed about 320 million years ago and left exposed by the last glaciation 14-20000 years ago, when the glaciers eroded away the softer rocks around it. It has a long history of occupation, from the Bronze age onwards [1500 BC]. It was the capital of the Votadini tribe in the late BC period. They allied with the Romans in the 1st C AD, and remained until the 5th C AD, after the Romans had left.
